questions.question: Which command summarizes interface IPv4 addresses and interface and protocol status?
questions.explanation: show ip interface brief gives a one-line summary per interface with the IP address and status columns.

option_explanations.A: The running configuration lists configured settings but does not summarize live interface and protocol status.
option_explanations.B: show ip interface brief gives a one-line summary per interface with the IP address and status columns.
option_explanations.C: This shows VLAN membership rather than IPv4 addresses and state columns.
option_explanations.D: The routing table lists prefixes rather than the requested per-port summary.

questions.question: Which command displays the IPv4 routing table?
questions.explanation: show ip route displays installed IPv4 routes, including directly connected routes.

option_explanations.A: This reports interface details and counters rather than installed IPv4 routes.
option_explanations.B: This lists VLANs rather than Layer 3 routes.
option_explanations.C: This reports system and software information.
option_explanations.D: show ip route displays installed IPv4 routes, including directly connected routes.

questions.question: What does the status of Gi0/0 indicate?

options.A: The interface and line protocol are both up.
options.C: The interface is up, but the line protocol is down.
options.D: The interface has no IPv4 address.

questions.explanation: Status and Protocol are separate columns. Status is up while Protocol is down, so Layer 2 is not operational.
questions.snippet:
Interface  IP-Address   OK? Method Status Protocol
Gi0/0      192.0.2.1    YES manual up     down

option_explanations.A: The protocol column is down, so the two columns are not both up.
option_explanations.B: The status shows up, not administratively down.
option_explanations.C: Status and Protocol are separate columns. Status is up while Protocol is down, so Layer 2 is not operational.
option_explanations.D: The exhibit shows an assigned IPv4 address, independent of the line protocol state.
